parameters.name: CallBack
parameters.description: The callback URL for job results. Only HTTP URLs are supported.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: A description of the watermark information.

parameters.name: Input
parameters.description:
The location of the input media object in OSS, specified as a JSON object. Currently, only video files are supported. For more information, see [Input](~~29253~~).

> - The OSS bucket must be in the same region as MPS.

- `Bucket`: The name of the input OSS bucket.

- `Location`: The region of the OSS bucket. This must be the same as the MPS region.

- `Object`: The object in the OSS bucket to be processed.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: The watermark embedding channel. Valid values: 0 (U channel), 1 (UV channels), and 2 (YUV channels).

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description:
The location of the output object in OSS, specified as a JSON object.

> - The OSS bucket must be in the same region as MPS.

parameters.name: Params
parameters.description:
Additional parameters for the watermarking job, specified as a JSON string. The following parameter is supported:

- `algoType`: The algorithm type. Default value: `v1`.

  - `v1`: The copyright watermark algorithm for long-form video. It supports only videos that are 3 minutes or longer.

  - `v2`: The copyright watermark algorithm for short-form video.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time for embedding the watermark, in seconds. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 0.

parameters.name: TotalTime
parameters.description: The total duration for embedding the watermark, in seconds. If unspecified, the watermark is applied to the entire video.

parameters.name: Url
parameters.description: A publicly accessible URL of the video. If specified, this URL is used as the job input and overrides the `Input` parameter.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: User-defined data. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes.
